title.big: Pipeline wall thickness, answered in chat
title.desc: Ask in plain English. Deckhand asks for what it needs, runs the calculation, and sends back a report you can keep.

turns.html: I've got a 12-inch export line going into 1500 m and need a quick wall-thickness screen before we lock the line pipe order. Can you check it across the codes?

Happy to screen it — two things drive the wall, so let me get them straight first:
  • Pressure basis — is the rating you'll give me the operating pressure or the design pressure? I size containment on design, so I need to know which one you're quoting.
  • Buckle arrestors — are you running them, or not? Without arrestors I have to carry the full propagation-buckle wall along the line, which is a much heavier pipe. With arrestors I only need the collapse wall between them. It swings the answer a lot, so I'll run whichever you've planned.
Then the basics: line size, steel grade, and water depth.
I screen carbon-steel line pipe against DNV-ST-F101, ASME B31 and PD 8010. Flexibles and risers are a different check, so I'd flag those and pass them on.
12.75-inch OD, grade X65, 1500 m water depth. The 150 bar I'm giving you is the design pressure, and we're planning buckle arrestors. Datasheet attached — 3 mm corrosion allowance in there too.

Got it — design pressure 150 bar, X65, 1500 m, with buckle arrestors. Basis I'll use: containment checked at design pressure, and collapse and propagation checked for the empty line at full depth. Codes: DNV-ST-F101, ASME B31 and PD 8010, then I pick the next standard schedule above the minimum. Running it now…

Here's the wall-thickness screen, with and without arrestors so you can see the trade:
CaseGoverning checkMin wallSelectedMargin
With arrestorsDNV-ST-F101 collapse14.9 mmSCH 80 · 17.5 mm✅ 59%
Without arrestorsDNV-ST-F101 propagation25.4 mmSCH 140 · 28.6 mm✅ 39%
DNV-ST-F101 governs both cases. With the arrestors you planned, SCH 80 carries it — dropping them would push you to SCH 140 line pipe.

report.title: Pipeline Wall-Thickness Screen
report.inputs:
Line
12.75 in OD · grade X65 (SMYS 448 MPa, SMTS 531 MPa)
Water depth 1500 m · Corrosion allowance 3 mm

Pressure basis
Design pressure 150 bar (15 MPa) — containment sized on design
Collapse & propagation checked empty at full depth

Branch
With buckle arrestors (collapse wall) · also screened without (propagation wall)
report.methodology:
1 · Containment (burst) checked at design pressure with zero external pressure — the route minimum.
2 · Collapse and propagation buckling checked for the empty line at the full 1500 m external head.
3 · Each wall stepped through DNV-ST-F101, ASME B31 and PD 8010; the highest utilisation governs.
4 · Minimum wall = thinnest section that keeps every check at or below 1.0.
5 · Selected wall = next standard pipe schedule above the minimum.
6 · Branch: with arrestors needs only the collapse wall; without, the heavier propagation wall.
report.outputs:
CaseGoverning checkUtilisationMin wallSelected
With arrestorsDNV-ST-F101 collapse0.6314.91 mmSCH 80 · 17.48 mm
Without arrestorsDNV-ST-F101 propagation0.7225.41 mmSCH 140 · 28.58 mm
Verdict: With buckle arrestors, SCH 80 (17.48 mm) carries the line at 59% margin. Without arrestors the propagation wall governs and you step up to SCH 140 (28.58 mm). DNV-ST-F101 is the governing code in both cases.
